requirements.text: The system should allow students to manage loans and bookings online, ensuring good service while maintaining a personal touch for exceptions.
Students should be able to check availability, borrow items, book study rooms, and view their current loans and fines online.
Librarians should have the ability to manage inventory easily, including adding or updating items, and to place holds or restrictions on accounts for students with outstanding fines.
There should be a way for librarians to handle unique circumstances and make context-based decisions.
The system should balance new features with the need for manual oversight when exceptions arise.
